items.headline: Sean McVay says Rams to 'evaluate everything' about kicking unit after OT loss
items.description: After the Rams missed a field goal attempt and had another blocked in Monday night's 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills, coach Sean McVay said Los Angeles will "evaluate everything" about the kicking unit.

items.headline: Bills QB Josh Allen earns first overtime win of career vs. Rams on MNF
items.description: Josh Allen came through with his usual late-game theatrics in leading the Bills to a 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on "Monday Night Football," breaking his careerlong winless streak in OT.

items.headline: Rams' Alaric Jackson punches Bills' Bradley Chubb after MNF
items.description: On the field after the Los Angeles Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Buffalo Bills on Monday night, Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb in a scene captured by ESPN's cameras at SoFi Stadium.

items.headline: Alaric Jackson throws a punch at Bradley Chubb after Bills-Rams
items.description: Alaric Jackson throws a punch at Bradley Chubb after Bills-Rams

items.headline: Bills, Josh Allen outlast Rams in overtime on MNF
items.description: Using a throwback offense with downhill runs and scrambles from their star QB, the Bills escape with the win.
